title: VTC Roles — List — payload
description: Enumerate the administrative roles a VTC holds — built-in and custom. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

includeBuiltIn.description: `true` (the default) returns built-in and custom roles; `false` returns custom roles only.

Response.title: VTC Roles — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/roles/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/roles/list/0.1#response.

roles.description: Every role matching the request, each with its full ceiling and approve ceiling. Complete — not paged: a community's role vocabulary is small and bounded.
